customers_say: Customers find the water purifier reliable, budget-friendly, and easy to use, with good installation and water quality that tests clean and pure. The water tastes good, and they appreciate the prompt service. However, opinions about customer service are mixed, with some praising the after-sales service while others report extremely poor customer care.

reviews.author: Govindraj Mutkiri
reviews.title: Excellent Installation Service by Aquaguard
reviews.body: The installation service was smooth and hassle-free. The technician was professional, explained the purifier's operation, checked the water TDS before and after purification, and completed the installation properly. Overall, I am satisfied with the installation service and the technician's work. Thank you...

reviews.author: kamalakannan
reviews.title: Very low TDS than normally allowed drinking level , no control on device
reviews.body: TDS level very low 30 which is below than normal , there is no TDS control in this device. Auquaguard installaton engineer & backend manager says this is how it works try to convince us TDS 30 is ok to drink, then why we to buy with mineral guard ? Poor customer service, installation don't have enough knowledge asked to buy addition connectors & charged us when all required already comes with unit itself

reviews.author: Mukul sinha
reviews.title: A good buy with average build quality
reviews.body: It’s working fine after installing a TDS controller, as the company doesn’t provide one. Although my tap water has a TDS of around 120 ppm, I purchased an RO purifier due to the presence of heavy metals. The RO reduced the TDS to 10–15 ppm, so a TDS controller was needed. However, since it bypasses some untreated water, the RO’s purpose is somewhat compromised, as some heavy metals may remain in the final water. Whole body is of plastic having build quality not as expected.Apperance is good, installation service was fast but after sale service is slow.Overall,a good buy,but let's see how it go

reviews.author: Helloworld
reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body: The water purifier itself seems good, but I had a disappointing experience with the installation technician. The technician showed me a TDS meter reading of 900+ ppm and recommended that I purchase an additional pre-filter. I declined because a pre-filter is primarily meant to remove suspended particles/impurities and does not reduce TDS. What concerned me more was that the technician did not check the TDS of the purified water after installation. He also told me that the filter warranty was only 1 year. reviews.author: Balajee Bhardwaj
reviews.title: Good performance and great water taste
reviews.body: Good water purifier that gets the job done. The filtration works great—it brought down the TDS effectively, and the water tastes fresh and clean with no chemical odor. The build quality is compact and fits nicely in the kitchen without taking up too much space. Water wastage is also relatively lower compared to standard RO models. Deducting one star only because the dispensing flow could be slightly faster and installation took a couple of days to schedule. Overall, reliable value for money.
